title: Per-state composite catalog
description: The contract between the Python preprocess pipeline (catalog_builder.build_catalog) and the TypeScript map app (catalog.ts parseCatalog). This file is the single source of truth — both sides must conform.

schema_version.description: Bumped on incompatible changes. Constant in code (CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION in compose.py and Catalog.schemaVersion in catalog.ts).

layers.description: Composite layer name (= OUTPUT_BASENAMES[canonical_type]) -> Layer descriptor.

canonical_type.description: One of the canonical-type keys: tower, parcel, distress_overlay, solar_facility, billboard, county_score, etc.

parquet_path.description: Either a file path (e.g. 'towers.parquet') OR a directory name (e.g. 'parcels') when `sharded` is true. Relative to composite/<fips>/.

geometry_type.description: Empty string when the layer has no rows or no detectable geometry type.

sharded.description: True when parquet_path points to a directory of per-shard parquets (chunked compose, ADR-051). Absent or false for single-file layers.

shard_count.description: Number of per-shard parquets when sharded=true. Required when sharded=true; absent otherwise.

geometry_type.description: Geometry type string for spatial views, null for tabular views.
